newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank poll -- economists see no rate change.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank poll -- economists see no rate change.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank change its leading interest rates this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
3. Will there be a rise in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 1
No 9
4. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 percent this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
5. Will the Bundesbank approve the plans of the government to the revaluation of assets?
Yes 6
No 3
Don't know 1
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3. 4. 5.

Andrew Davies, London Bond Broking No No No Yes No
Stefan Bergheim, Keinwort Benson, Ffm No No No Yes Yes
